Same regular-conditional-distribution result (Probability: Theory and Examples, 5th ed., Sec 4.1.3). Alternative source for T-001 Assumption 4.
Consistency and asymptotic normality of maximum likelihood under misspecification; used for D_n/n -> Delta-ell-star in T-007b.
Limiting distribution of the log-likelihood-ratio statistic for non-nested misspecified models; source of the omega^2 variance in T-007b and T-005c.
Misspecification-robust bias correction 2 tr(J^-1 V) replacing AIC's 2k; cited in T-007c.
Bernstein-von Mises under misspecification; posterior concentration at the pseudo-true parameter. Regularity condition R2 of T-005.
Singular learning theory: free-energy expansion with the real log canonical threshold lambda <= k/2 replacing k/2, invalidating BIC for singular models. Basis of T-007c and the T-006 deferral.
WAIC is asymptotically equivalent to the Bayes generalization error for singular models, unlike AIC/BIC. Justifies making PSIS-LOO/WAIC primary under D-004.
WBIC at inverse temperature 1/log n as a singularity-valid substitute for BIC; required cross-check under D-003 condition 4.
Limiting distribution of the likelihood-ratio statistic when the true parameter lies on the boundary; part of the no-significance-reading rule in T-007c.
Chi-squared mixture null distributions for boundary parameters in mixture and variance-component models; T-007c.
PSIS-LOO estimator, p_loo, and the Pareto k-hat < 0.7 diagnostic. Regularity condition R4 of T-005.
The standard error of an elpd difference is anticonservative for nested models; hazard 2 in T-005 section 5.
Iterative bridge-sampling estimator for marginal likelihoods; the estimator declared in D-003 condition 3.
